identity: An enterprise record widget for finding a record, changing and saving its fields, or looking up an account balance and recording a report.

scenarios.name: mainframe
scenarios.screen: An 80-column, 24-row host screen shows a blank record-key entry field and keyboard instructions. No record is open, and no edit values or save receipt are shown.
never: A record editor already filled with the requested record
A save receipt before a record is saved

arrangements.text: The record-key label sits beside its entry field, with keyboard instructions below and status at the bottom of the host screen.
The record-key label sits above its entry field, with keyboard instructions and status beneath the entry area.

scenarios.name: mainframe-lookup
scenarios.screen: An 80-column, 24-row host screen shows numbered inquiry-menu choices and a blank option field. The account list, inquiry detail, and report entry are closed.
never: A list already advanced to a later page
A balance already entered in the report

arrangements.text: The numbered choices form a column above the option field, with status at the bottom of the host screen.
The numbered choices sit beside the option prompt, with status below both.

scenarios.name: swing
scenarios.screen: A record tree and a scrollable table show the directory, typically 48 records. The tabbed editor has no loaded record, and no save receipt is shown.
never: The requested record already open with edited values
An editor tab detached into a separate window
A save receipt before a record is saved

arrangements.text: The tree sits left of the record table, and the tabbed editor sits to their right.
The tree sits left of the record table, and the tabbed editor sits below the table.

scenarios.name: sapgui
scenarios.screen: A transaction-command field is ready for entry. The record maintenance form and F4 help are closed, and no record values are loaded.
never: The requested record already loaded in the maintenance form
A save confirmation before a record is saved

arrangements.text: The transaction-command field sits beside its label near the top of the task area, with status below.
The transaction-command field sits below its label, with status beneath the command area.

scenarios.name: win95
scenarios.screen: A record directory is available for choosing a record, typically from 48 entries. The property sheet is closed, so its tabs, group boxes, spin controls, and Apply, OK, and Cancel buttons are not yet visible.
never: A property sheet already open on the requested record
An Apply confirmation before any edit
Changed values already filled into the requested record

arrangements.text: The record list occupies the main task area, with its open control beside the list.
The record list sits above its open control within the task area.
arrangements.traits: skin choice: open control below list
